description: Drafts a GitHub issue about c2n met while building an app: a component bug, something documented that does not work, a missing feature or component, an API that made the common case hard, a mismatch between get_component and the behaviour, or a workaround you had to write (plain HTML instead of a c2-* element, a CSS or timing hack). Fills in the installed version and the framework, checks the reproduction with validate_markup, looks for existing issues that name the component (only its tag is sent to GitHub), and returns the draft plus a link that opens the pre-filled issue form. It never submits anything: show the draft to the developer, who reviews it and submits it. Keep the reproduction minimal and free of application code, internal URLs, names and data. Ask the developer first whether they want to report it, and call it only when they agree.

building.description: What the developer was building, in a sentence, without private details

component.description: The element or package the problem is in: `c2-table`, `table` or `@c2n/table`

kind.description: `bug`: wrong behaviour; `gap`: documented or implied but missing; `feature`: a capability or component c2n does not have; `papercut`: works, but the common case is hard; `docs`: the docs or an MCP answer is wrong

repro.description: The smallest markup, CSS or script that shows it (checked with validate_markup)

reproFilename.description: File name that sets how the reproduction is read (`repro.tsx`, `repro.css`); HTML by default

searchExisting.description: Search GitHub for existing issues that name this component (sends only the component's tag; needs network access)

title.description: One line naming the problem, e.g. "renderCell node does not fill the cell"

workaround.description: What was done instead, if anything

name: report_issue
title: Draft a component issue
